'''Kapin Toologin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Insurer|insurance salesman]]. While on holiday aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']], rumors circulated that he was really a powerful [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].
